<%
    var attr = 'name="dialplan" description="Regex/XML Dialplan"';
    var body = (function (base, dir, sub) {
        var basedir = `${base}/${dir}`, fpath = `${basedir}/${sub}.xml`, stat = fs.existsSync(fpath) && fs.statSync(fpath);
        if (!sub) {
            return fs.statSync(basedir).isDirectory() ? fs.readdirSync(basedir).filter(sub=>fs.statSync(`${basedir}/${sub}`).isFile()).map(sub=>include(`${dir}/${sub}`)).join('') : undefined;
        } else if (stat && stat.isFile() && !stat.size) {
            return (attr = 'name="result"') && ``;
        } else {
            return include(`${dir}/${sub}.xml`);
        }
    })(path.dirname(__filename), query.section, query['Caller-Context']) // __dirname, 'dialplan', 'default'
 %>
<section <%- attr %>>
<%- body %>
